scope.reason_for_subset: The 12 new evals cover the three merged sub-skills and the collisions the merge introduced. Four were selected as the highest-risk behavioural cases: the two hard gates that a content merge is most likely to weaken (no fabricated signals, no auto-send) and the two collisions most likely to mis-route (infra vs math on inbox count, ops vs diagnose on premature verdicts). The remaining 8 are structural/routing claims covered by the deterministic coverage audit.

baseline_omitted_because: Only the with_skill arm was executed. Reporting a baseline that was not run would be fabrication. iteration-2 remains the last baseline comparison and covers the pre-merge skills.

static_review.regression_found_and_fixed: Orchestrator description reached 1841 chars against a 1024 limit (score 80, one CRITICAL). Trimmed to 1012 chars without dropping the new capabilities; now 100/100. Note the pre-merge description was already 1069 chars, i.e. it was over the limit before the merge.

coverage_audit.gap_found: The eval asserting the infra skill refuses filter-evasion tactics had no backing text. A '## Boundaries' section was added to gtm-outbound-infra/SKILL.md rather than deleting the assertion.
